data.long_meaning: Hunaifah is a name of Arabic origin, derived from the word 'Hanif' which means 'monotheist' or 'protector of the faith'. It is a name deeply rooted in Islamic history and spirituality, symbolizing the unwavering commitment to faith and protection of its teachings. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian.
